# Omnibox

The omnibox is the single entry point for search and commands — the browser-shell address bar and the Command Center's central AI/search field share it.

`PhantomPortals.Omnibox` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.Omnibox />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.Omnibox"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Universal search / command field. Prefix ">" for command mode is a convention the consumer handles in onSubmit.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `shortcut` | `string` |  |
| `onSubmit` | `(value: string) => void` |  |
